For frame_190.00.png at 190.0s, spatial_grounder says the panda "is not wearing glasses, a bow tie, or depicted as a broom or Einstein." For frame_192.00.png at 192.0s, spatial_grounder likewise reports "no glasses, bow tie, broom, or Einstein-like depiction."
